## Executive Summary & Overview

HarvestLink is a facilitation-only marketplace connecting independent food producers with foodservice buyers, enforcing compliance-documentation completeness without acquiring Food Business Operator status. The platform introduces a new digital product into Thornbury Foods Group's estate, requiring integration with existing identity, data warehouse, and API gateway infrastructure while deliberately avoiding direct integration with legacy supplier master data or compliance document stores to maintain its facilitation-only legal posture. Overall impact is **Medium** — seven new components with controlled blast radius, seven existing CIs impacted (primarily integration infrastructure), and three external dependencies newly surfaced by this assessment.

- **Overall impact level:** Medium — seven new components, all Low-to-Medium individual blast radius; no Tier-1 system modification required, but Kong API Gateway (Tier-1 CI) must route all HarvestLink traffic per EA4 mandate
- **Existing systems:** 7 CIs impacted, 2 explicitly excluded by architecture decision (SMDS, Compliance Document Store — exclusion is intentional to preserve facilitation-only posture); duplicate-build risk: none found — no existing service provides producer-to-buyer marketplace with compliance-documentation-completeness scoring
- **External dependencies:** 3 total, 1 newly surfaced by this assessment (external-party identity provider gap — Azure AD is employee-only per CI-APP-005)
- **Flags:** CMDB/KB mismatch on CI-APP-007 (Kong API Gateway) — CMDB states "mandatory for new digital products from 2026", KB EA4 states same mandate but does not explicitly name Kong; treated as consistent. No stale or contaminated exports detected.

## Non-Functional & Regulatory Impact

**SLA Impact:** FR-003 (traceability records) and FR-008 (time-to-first-compliant-trade measurement) impose 99.9% availability requirements per kb-L1-enterprise-security ES4, higher than the group's standard 99.5% for non-critical digital products. This elevates HarvestLink's infrastructure tier and requires dedicated monitoring/alerting.

**Data Retention Impact:** FR-001 (FBO attestation) requires 6-year retention per kb-L1-enterprise-security ES3 Group Records Retention Policy, extending beyond the standard 3-year retention for transactional data. Attestation records must be segregated with extended lifecycle policies.

**Regulatory Boundaries:** FR-001, FR-003, FR-004, FR-006 collectively enforce a facilitation-only legal posture to avoid acquiring FBO status. This constraint prohibits direct integration with CI-APP-003 (Supplier Master Data System) and CI-APP-004 (Compliance Document Store) — HarvestLink must maintain its own producer/distributor records and compliance documentation to preserve the legal boundary. Any future integration with these systems would trigger a regulatory re-assessment.

## Existing-System Impact

**Capability check (service catalog, service grain):** Service catalog is empty — no parent enterprise services to check. The closest conceptual match within Thornbury Foods Group's known estate would be CI-APP-009 (Legacy Wholesale CRM), which manages buyer relationships for the wholesale division, but it does not provide producer onboarding, compliance-documentation-completeness scoring, or marketplace matching — HarvestLink's core value proposition. No duplicate-build risk identified.

## Components Identified

| Requirement | Component (new/existing) | Blast Radius | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | Onboarding Service (new) | Low | New service, no modification to existing systems. Stores FBO attestations with 6-year retention. Depends on external-party identity provider (gap identified above). Single-purpose, isolated failure domain. |
| FR-002 | Discovery & Matching Service (new) | Medium | New service, but exposes compliance-completeness scores calculated by Compliance Documentation Service. Failure affects buyer search/discovery UX but does not block producer onboarding or traceability record entry. Moderate user-facing impact. |
| FR-003 | Traceability Service (new) | Medium | New service, 99.9% availability requirement per ES4. Immutable audit log for dual-signed traceability records. Failure blocks traceability record finalisation, which may be required for active regulatory defence. Moderate regulatory impact, but isolated to HarvestLink's own records (does not touch CI-APP-004). |
| FR-004 | Compliance Documentation Service (new) | Medium | New service, stores producer-attested allergen declarations. Failure blocks allergen declaration finalisation but does not affect existing group compliance workflows (CI-APP-004 deliberately excluded). Moderate regulatory impact, isolated failure domain. |
| FR-005 | Transaction Limit Enforcement Service (new) | Low | New service, enforces server-side transaction-value limits based on compliance-completeness score. Failure blocks transactions for producers with incomplete compliance documentation, but does not affect existing group transaction systems (no ERP/WMS integration). Single-purpose, isolated failure domain. |
| FR-006 | Transaction Routing Service (new) | Medium | New service, enforces facilitation-only routing (never records HarvestLink as taking possession/title). Failure blocks all trades, but isolated to HarvestLink's own transaction flow (no ERP/WMS integration). Moderate business impact, but no cross-system cascade risk. |
| FR-007 | Cohort Management Service (new) | Low | New service, restricts pilot-phase onboarding/trading to designated cohort. Failure affects pilot-phase access control but does not block existing group operations. Single-purpose, isolated failure domain. |
| FR-008 | Reporting Service (new) | Low | New service, publishes time-to-first-compliant-trade and compliance-documentation-completeness metrics to Snowflake (CI-APP-006) via Kong API Gateway (CI-APP-007). Best-effort availability per ES4 (outbound-only reporting feed, not a compliance record). Failure affects BI/reporting but does not block producer onboarding or trading. Low operational impact. |
| FR-009 | Reporting Service (existing, shared with FR-008) | Low | Same component as FR-008. Publishes compliance-documentation-completeness score at first trade. Low operational impact. |

## Data Model & Schema Impact

**New Entities Introduced:**
- **Producer:** id, name, fbo_attestation (6-year retention), onboarding_start_timestamp, compliance_completeness_score, transaction_value_limit, cohort_eligibility_flag
- **Distributor:** id, name, fbo_attestation (6-year retention), onboarding_start_timestamp, cohort_eligibility_flag
- **Buyer:** id, name, organization, authentication_method (external-party identity provider)
- **TraceabilityRecord:** id, producer_id, distributor_id, producer_signature, distributor_signature, signed_at, immutable_audit_log_entry (append-only)
- **AllergenDeclaration:** id, producer_id, product_id, allergen_list, producer_attestation, attestation_timestamp, status (pending/finalised)
- **Transaction:** id, producer_id, buyer_id, transaction_value, compliance_completeness_score_at_transaction, routed_as_facilitation_only_flag
- **ComplianceCompletenessScore:** producer_id, score_value, calculated_at, first_trade_timestamp

**Schema Changes to Existing Systems:** None. HarvestLink maintains its own data model independently to preserve facilitation-only posture. No modification to CI-APP-003 (SMDS) or CI-APP-004 (Compliance Document Store).

**Validation Rules:**
- FBO attestation (FR-001) must be explicitly confirmed before producer/distributor onboarding completes
- Traceability record (FR-003) requires both producer_signature and distributor_signature before status transitions to finalised
- Allergen declaration (FR-004) requires producer_attestation before status transitions to finalised
- Transaction value (FR-005) must not exceed producer's current transaction_value_limit (server-side enforcement)
- Transaction routing (FR-006) must set routed_as_facilitation_only_flag = true for every transaction; any false value is a data integrity violation

## Integration Landscape & External Dependencies

**Upstream Data Sources:**
1. **External-party identity provider (newly surfaced):** Azure AD (CI-APP-005) is employee-only. HarvestLink requires authentication for producers, distributors, and buyers (FR-001, FR-003, FR-004). **Gap identified:** No existing external-party identity provider in the CMDB. HarvestLink must integrate with Azure AD B2C, Auth0, or equivalent third-party identity provider. This is a blocking dependency for all authentication-dependent FRs (FR-001, FR-003, FR-004).

**Downstream Consumers:**
2. **Snowflake Data Warehouse (CI-APP-006):** HarvestLink's Reporting Service publishes time-to-first-compliant-trade (FR-008) and compliance-documentation-completeness (FR-009) metrics to Snowflake via Kong API Gateway (CI-APP-007). Integration pattern per kb-L1-enterprise-architecture EA4: publish through API Gateway, not directly or via ESB.

**Third-party Services:**
3. **Payment gateway (named in PRD constraints, not yet selected):** FR-005 enforces transaction-value limits, implying a payment/transaction flow. PRD does not name a specific payment gateway. HarvestLink will require integration with a third-party payment provider (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, or equivalent) to process transactions. This is a known external dependency, not newly surfaced, but must be selected and integrated during design/build.

**Integration Infrastructure:**
- **Kong API Gateway (CI-APP-007):** Mandatory entry point for all HarvestLink API traffic per kb-L1-enterprise-architecture EA4 and CMDB status. All mobile app requests, external integrations, and Snowflake publishing must route through Kong.

## Assumptions & Out of Scope

**Assumptions:**
- Facilitation-only legal structure will hold up to validation with a design-partner local authority or legal counsel (underlies FR-001, FR-006) — not yet validated, per PRD § Assumptions
- Producers and distributors have sufficient digital access to complete on-platform attestation/sign-off workflows (underlies FR-001, FR-003, FR-004) — not yet confirmed for target user segment
- Buyers will trust the displayed compliance-completeness score without independent audit (underlies FR-002) — not yet validated with foodservice buyer segment
- Pilot cohort will be selected and onboarded manually by product/operations team (underlies FR-007) — no self-service application flow in scope
- External-party identity provider (Azure AD B2C, Auth0, or equivalent) will be selected and integrated before pilot launch — blocking dependency for FR-001, FR-003, FR-004
- Payment gateway (Stripe, Adyen, or equivalent) will be selected and integrated before pilot launch — blocking dependency for FR-005

**Out of Scope:**
- Integration with CI-APP-001 (SAP ERP) — no financial/accounting integration required for pilot phase
- Integration with CI-APP-002 (Manhattan WMS) — HarvestLink does not take physical possession of food (FR-006)
- Integration with CI-APP-003 (Supplier Master Data System) — deliberately excluded to preserve facilitation-only posture
- Integration with CI-APP-004 (Compliance Document Store) — deliberately excluded to preserve facilitation-only posture
- Integration with CI-APP-009 (Legacy Wholesale CRM) — new buyer segment, no integration required for pilot phase
- Producer/distributor offboarding or suspension workflows — coverage gap identified in PRD § Open Questions, not addressed by any FR
- Dispute handling when a buyer contests a delivered trade's compliance documentation after dual sign-off — coverage gap identified in PRD § Open Questions, not addressed by any FR
- General availability beyond pilot cohort (FR-007) — pilot phase only, per PRD scope
